risk_note: RV2 (admin/**, apps/api/scripts). First super admin bootstrap CLI run by the owner in a terminal: refuses when any super exists (in-transaction advisory lock and recheck), scrypt password hash, TOTP secret shown once and confirmed with a code consumed in PG before one transaction writes the account, binding and audit; app and login echoed for a yes confirmation; managed DB handles keep the verify-full host check. Orchestrator wording-only test edits decided 2026-10-06 (规划/11 §7.3 item 11): two comments no longer name the admin database URL variable; the RFC 6238 test seed is encoded at runtime instead of a gitleaks-flagged literal (couli-runs/F1-06c/orchestrator-test-edit.diff). Written by hand.
